leverage.exposure: No leverage, in any branch. If every one of the four live bids wins, the total committed still sits comfortably inside available cash with room to spare, and nothing recommended here opens a negative position. The real exposure is the points penalty for an incomplete squad, which is already being addressed, and the tail risk that Sylla is deleted from the squad by a transfer at a moment of someone else's choosing between now and the lock.

binding_gap: Still the empty squad slot and the absence of any legal formation, and it is still fixed by the first defender to land. Beyond that, the binding constraint has quietly shifted from the German deadline this evening to the matchday lock, because the Sylla exit window now reaches past it. That makes the cheap insurance body a live requirement through the weekend rather than something that stops mattering at six o'clock tonight.

verdict.headline: A quiet run with one instruction that needed correcting.
verdict.headline_short: A quiet run with one instruction that needed correcting.
verdict.detail: A quiet run with one instruction that needed correcting. Nothing resolved since the last briefing: the squad is unchanged, cash is unchanged, and all four of Georg's bids are still live at the right numbers. No action is needed right now. The one thing that changed is the Sylla horizon. Schalke-side reporting today does not corroborate the Club Brugge approach and says the club has rejected the money on the table, so today's risk is lower than yesterday's briefing implied; but the same piece confirms Turkish clubs can still buy until the fourth and Saudi clubs until the sixth, so the exit risk now runs past the matchday lock rather than expiring with the German window this evening. That resolves a contradiction that was sitting inside the standing plan, and it changes what Georg should do at the recount later this morning.

sell.reason: Unchanged, and no sale should be made before the buys resolve. Sylla stays sell-when-legal, and selling him voluntarily is now more attractive than it was yesterday, not less, precisely because the deletion risk survives past the lock: a sale banks the money at a time of Georg's choosing, a deletion does not. The sale is only legal in specific shapes, and in one otherwise plausible shape it is illegal because defenders cap at five in every formation. After the window closes the funding sale is Widmer, who is outside the best eleven either way, so the sale costs nothing in points. Bernardo comes second and only if his Kickbase status flag is still showing near the lock.

standing.name: Sylla
standing.why: Replaces SELL-syl (closed) - PROMOTED from "funding leg 1, only if a bid lands" to the FIRST sale to execute, with a hard deadline. NEW: fussballeuropa 31.08.2026 08:45Z - Club Brugge intends to bid before the deadline, Schalke has cut the ask to a EUR 4M minimum and is only deciding whether letting him go now makes sporting sense; CEO Tillmann: a sale "is currently included in our budget figures". Corroborated by schalketotal 24.08/26.08/27.08 (Schalke needs the transfer millions, price lowered). German window shuts 01.09 18:00Z; the Belgian window runs ~4 days longer, so an exit can complete after the German deadline - the risk does not end at 18:00Z. He is the worst scorer in the squad at ap 21, mv 9.096.588 with sdmvt -670.248 (~670k/day of decay), and he was always the designated sale. Sale allowance is ZERO until a buy lands (squad exactly 11) - see BUY B3z76og on Nguefack, which exists to unlock this. Dump to Kickbase at mv rather than list: a manager ask clears +3,06% to +4,35% (~280k-400k more) but takes days he does not have, and Keidel just proved the manager route works only when someone wants the player. Sell the moment the allowance exists.

standing.name: Sylla
standing.why: CONDITIONAL SELL - execute ONLY once the squad is 12+ AND the post-sale shape still fills a formation. Moussa Sylla, Schalke ATT, mv 9.225.516, ap 21, mv falling (sd -198.163). NEWS IS LIVE AND DATED TODAY: recklinghaeuser-zeitung.de "Deadline Day 2026: Schalke-04-Transfergeruechte um Moussa Sylla", published 2026-09-01, reports (via Africafoot) that CLUB BRUEGGE intends a concrete Deadline-Day approach and is ready to submit an offer if Schalke approve; Schalke are weighing it because they urgently need transfer income, and Bruegge are selling Champions League football. Window shuts 20:00 CET = 2026-09-01T18:00Z. DATE TRAP CLEARED THIS RUN: the Sky Sport headline "Moussa Sylla verlaesst Schalke 04" is 25.01.2026 and concerns the collapsed NEW YORK CITY FC move (7M incl. bonuses) - LAST SEASON, same family as the ruhrnachrichten and sportschau items already logged. It does NOT corroborate Bruegge. The recklinghaeuser piece dated 01.09.2026 is the only current source. FITNESS: fit, not on Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte, started MD1 (ap 21). THE COST OF SELLING IS 21 ap AND NOTHING ELSE: at 13 = 1/6/3/3 the best XI is 5-2-3 for 1442 ap with Sylla; after the sale, 12 = 1/6/3/2 fields 5-3-2 for 1421 ap. Twenty-one points to bank 9.225.516 and retire a deletion risk. THE DELETION RISK IS THE REAL POINT: if the move completes, Kickbase removes him and compensates at mv, dropping a 12-man squad to 11 = 1GK/6DEF/2MID/2ATT, which fills NO formation because DEF caps at 5 - that is a -100 on MD2 arriving without Georg touching anything. SHAPE GATE, do not skip it: at 12 = 1/6/2/3 selling Sylla is ILLEGAL. Only after Amoako (B3rkra9) lands does 13 = 1/6/3/3 make the sale legal at 1/6/3/2 = 5-3-2. If Amoako is lost at ~10:45Z the sale simply cannot happen today and the risk rides into the Belgian window - accept that rather than selling into an illegal shape. SEQUENCE: 09:23Z ter Horst resolves, ~10:45Z Amoako, 11:52Z Maluze, then recount and sell before 18:00Z.

buy.reason: Nothing new on the board is worth owning. Two Schalke defenders were dumped onto the Kickbase market within about an hour of each other: Gosens, who is carrying a thigh injury with no dated return and who scores negative points when he does play, and Woeber, whose points return is by a distance the worst of anything on the board or in the squad. Both are listed at exactly market value, which is what makes them tempting, and neither is a cheap body worth having when a defender is not the shape Georg is short of. The one genuinely interesting arrival is Aseko, who is a real asset rather than filler, a permanent signing from Bayern on a long contract for serious money, but he has no minutes yet, Frankfurt started Maluze ahead of him, and he expires after the German deadline so he cannot do the job a body is being bought for today. He is logged as a watch, to be promoted only on a dated lineup putting him in the starting eleven.

AFFORDABILITY AT THE REAL NUMBERS: 9.700.000 ter Horst + 3.600.000 Maluze + 2.000.000 Krattenmacher + 3.500.000 Amoako = 18.800.000 against cash 20.577.522, leaving +1.777.522 if all four land. Linguini07 paid 1.721.810 for Awortwie-Grant (8984, Paderborn DEF) against mv 1.545.176 = PLUS 11,43%, and get_player confirms st=1, "Lateral ligament injury - out for about 6 weeks".
